title: feat: Switch/Toggle widget
body:
Here is the switch/toggle widget that adds a boolean conjunctive filter and removes it with a checkbox.

Use case is hiding/showing all results that have for example `free_shipping: true`. When checked, only items with this attribute `true` will be displayed. When unchecked, all items will be displayed.

I renamed it from `switch` to `toggle` because naming variables `switch` in JavaScript caused issues as this is a reserved keyword.

Comments welcome
